recipes.name: Non-Alcoholic Mulled Wine
instructions: Add all of the ingredients to a large pot over medium-high heat.
Partially cover and let simmer for 20 minutes.
Strain into your favourite cups, garnish as desired, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Aim to purchase juices that are 100% fruit juice only, without added sugars, if possible.
Storage When cooled completely, the mulled "wine" can be stored in the fridge for up to 3 days.
